samples.title: Phân loại rác
samples.prompt: Why might people support the proposal that neighbourhoods should make household waste sorting easier? Is this a positive or negative development?
requirementsVi: Trả lời vì sao có người ủng hộ.
Đánh giá tích cực hay tiêu cực và giải thích.
Thừa nhận điều kiện, kết cả hai câu trả lời.
samples.summaryVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are understandable reasons why people may support the proposal that neighbourhoods should make household waste sorting easier. I consider this a mainly positive development when it is organised with practical needs in mind. Its value comes from the help it can offer in daily life, rather than from the idea simply sounding modern or attractive.
paragraphs.noteVi: Trả lời ngắn cả hai câu hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 1 — vì sao?
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that more recyclable material can be collected separately. This is possible because clear containers reduce the chance that paper and plastic become mixed with food waste. For example, a family can keep a small box for clean bottles instead of putting them in the same bag as dinner leftovers. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 2 — đánh giá
paragraphs.text: I see the development as positive because it gives people a useful option, provided that the main obstacles are recognised. One concern is that residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. This is connected with the fact that the instructions and collection system may not match. Ignoring that concern would weaken the case for the proposal, so support should include an effort to improve how it works.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đánh giá có lý do và giới hạn.

paragraphs.label: Ví dụ về điều kiện
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to provide simple labels and explain how each type of waste is collected. For example, a building manager could place picture labels above bins and publish a reliable collection schedule. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Minh họa cách giữ lợi ích và giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, people have good reason to support this approach because more recyclable material can be collected separately. I regard it as mainly positive, but the result depends on practical planning. A flexible approach that listens to the people involved is more likely to deliver the intended value.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt cả lý do và đánh giá.

paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to improve waste facilities and explain how visitors can avoid leaving rubbish. For example, organisers could use the clean-up record to decide where covered bins and clear signs are most needed. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Minh họa cách giữ lợi ích và giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, people have good reason to support this approach because volunteers can improve a public place and understand the scale of the problem. I regard it as mainly positive, but the result depends on practical planning. A flexible approach that listens to the people involved is more likely to deliver the intended value.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt cả lý do và đánh giá.

samples.title: Tiết kiệm nước
samples.prompt: Why might people support the proposal that communities should encourage practical water-saving habits? Is this a positive or negative development?
requirementsVi: Trả lời vì sao có người ủng hộ.
Đánh giá tích cực hay tiêu cực và giải thích.
Thừa nhận điều kiện, kết cả hai câu trả lời.
samples.summaryVi: Thói quen tiết kiệm nước cần đi cùng cách báo và sửa rò rỉ rõ trách nhiệm.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are understandable reasons why people may support the proposal that communities should encourage practical water-saving habits. I consider this a mainly positive development when it is organised with practical needs in mind. Its value comes from the help it can offer in daily life, rather than from the idea simply sounding modern or attractive.
paragraphs.noteVi: Trả lời ngắn cả hai câu hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 1 — vì sao?
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that people can avoid wasting treated water. This is possible because noticing leaks and unnecessary running taps can reduce waste without removing essential uses. For example, a household can repair a dripping tap and use a bowl when washing a small amount of produce. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thói quen tiết kiệm nước cần đi cùng cách báo và sửa rò rỉ rõ trách nhiệm.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 2 — đánh giá
paragraphs.text: I see the development as positive because it gives people a useful option, provided that the main obstacles are recognised. One concern is that simple advice may overlook problems beyond a resident's control. This is connected with the fact that responsibility for repairs may be unclear. Ignoring that concern would weaken the case for the proposal, so support should include an effort to improve how it works.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đánh giá có lý do và giới hạn.

paragraphs.label: Ví dụ về điều kiện
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to give residents an easy way to report leaks and explain who should respond. For example, a building manager could keep a repair log and confirm when each report has been checked. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Minh họa cách giữ lợi ích và giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, people have good reason to support this approach because people can avoid wasting treated water. I regard it as mainly positive, but the result depends on practical planning. A flexible approach that listens to the people involved is more likely to deliver the intended value.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt cả lý do và đánh giá.
